title: Don't Let Dragon Light the Pumpkin
idea: Eight trend tests #06 (Pray For Me slow-motion run): Dragon's pumpkin helmet lights up, his friends run in slow motion from the fire he sneezes

hook.what: a jack-o'-lantern's eyes light up and the potato under it puffs his cheeks

captions.text: Never let Dragon light the pumpkin.

the fire leaves the pumpkin's grin (4.7): a big fwoomp

a calm-looking breath out (both of them, 10.7)
